summary: Master the art of communication during change with our specialized training. Empower your organization to thrive in times of transformation.
lede: Change management communication helps teams plan, deliver and measure messages that support adoption during organizational change. This training is for change managers, internal communication specialists, HR partners, and project or transformation leads who need to align stakeholders and guide people through a rollout. Participants practice stakeholder mapping, audience-specific message design and channel planning, then develop resistance response approaches and scorecards using feedback, communication measures and adoption indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to communicate change clearly, coordinate stakeholders, and support adoption across live transformation work.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to a standard office suite, and a current or recent change example if possible. Familiarity with stakeholder lists, rollout plans, communication calendars, or manager briefings will help you complete the exercises more effectively.
